description: Land Acquisition - Wellawa, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land descriptions, claimants, original claimants, and land extents. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
